cleansingStrength.rationale: C5: Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate (2) is an alkyl-sulfate defining anionic with only one prominent buffer (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 4); polyglyceryl esters and charcoal are not buffers -> strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Nigella oil and guar add refatting/conditioning; they never move the C5 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: W-RICH by formula: prominent payload lipid (Nigella Sativa Seed Oil 5) converging with a cationic guar (8); Section 5 counts W-RICH as a rich architecture. C2 itself is not met (no pearlizing/fatty route; Polyglycerin-10 is not a listed humectant).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Single liquid oil + single guar in a strong ALS chassis; without C2 the care may be only one meaningful system (moderate). Value rests on the mechanical W-RICH reading.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Strong ALS reset and a liquid (non-waxy) oil argue that residue could be light.
